cleaning_notes: sample_list.xlsx: group lists in columns 0-1 (controls, uncomplicated) and 3-4 (complicated); TMT layout in columns 10-16 (plexes B1-B11, channel 126 = pooled internal standard 'IS1'-'IS11'). 52 dogs; every dog in the group lists is in the layout once and vice versa.
IDs with leading/trailing spaces were stripped: '2z '.
Plex Bk in sample_list.xlsx is taken to be fraction Fk in B_Proteins.txt (same numbering, 11 of each; plex B11 holds only 2 samples). The file does not state this mapping explicitly.
B_Proteins.txt has 677 protein rows; only rows with Master = 'IsMasterProtein' are used (224 proteins). Candidate and rejected master rows are not used.

Abundance columns: the export has no raw per-channel 'Abundance' columns and no 'Abundances (Normalized)' columns. It has 'Abundances (Grouped)' (66 columns, 6 channels x 11 plexes; channel 126 is exactly 100.0 wherever present, i.e. Proteome Discoverer scaled each plex to its internal standard) and 'Abundance Ratio' (55 columns, sample / channel 126). Values here are log2(grouped abundance of the dog's channel / grouped abundance of channel 126 of the same plex), computed in this script. Because the grouped abundances are already scaled to the standard, this equals the log2 of PD's Abundance Ratio: 8029 cells agree within 0.01 log2 units (max difference 0.0000, from rounding to 1 decimal), 0 disagree.

'Abundance Ratio' has the value 0.010 in 1 cells where the dog's grouped abundance is empty; this is Proteome Discoverer's minimum-ratio placeholder for a missing channel, not a measurement. Those cells are null.

Missing values are null: 3619 of 11648 protein x dog cells (31.1%). The gaps follow the plex: a protein missing in a plex's standard (channel 126) is missing for all dogs of that plex. Proteins observed per dog: median 155.0, range 149-158. Proteins observed in all 52 dogs: 95; in none: 7.
Plex B11 channels 129, 130, 131 hold no sample but carry 206 non-empty grouped abundances (spurious signal). They are not read.

172 of 224 master proteins carry a gene symbol (GN= in the description); the other 52 have only a description (many 'Uncharacterized protein'). Of the gene symbols, 12 are 'LOC' placeholders. data.md gives 163 with a gene symbol; no count tried here reproduces 163 (see the checks file). The variable's 'original' field holds accession | gene | description.
128 master proteins have at least 2 unique peptides (the article's reporting rule); all 224 master proteins are kept, filter on the dictionary note if needed.
Variable names are p_<UniProt accession> in lower case with non-alphanumerics replaced by '_'.

Controls (IDs ending in 'z') are group 'control', timepoint 'single'; infected dogs are timepoint 'admission' (archived serum; the timing relative to treatment is not in the files). The complicated/uncomplicated label is in the outcomes file only.
The pooled standard contains serum of all dogs, so the ratios are slightly self-referential (record).
No covariates (age, sex, breed, clinical pathology) are in the files.
